item.title: Just in case ...
item.description:
… you need a good read at the intersection of novel, philosophy, and hands-on discussion of engineering design it is time to revisit Zen and the Art of Motorcycle Maintenance.

Finally managed to read it in full and, while definitely an unconventional book, definitely a great one. And even some nicely concise explanations On the Scientific Method included for free. But that might be too much of an academic’s perspective on a summer read 🎓 ☺️.
